description.text:
Striking Competition (炫奇争胜) was the second enhanced expansion (强化包) of the Simplified Chinese game, part of the Shining Synergy series. It went on sale on 17 March 2023 in packs of six cards, two of them holo. Oricorio GX is on its cover.

It brought the TAG TEAMs Arceus & Dialga & Palkia GX, Venusaur & Snivy GX, Charizard & Braixen GX, Mega Lopunny & Jigglypuff GX, Trevenant & Dusknoir GX and Naganadel & Guzzlord GX, with the Supporters Misty & Lorelei and Rosa, Great Catcher and the Island Challenge Amulet. Its main cards are numbered out of 61; full-art and special art cards, rainbow cards and gold cards run to 99.

Two of its cards were printed with mistakes: a wording slip in Alolan Raichu's attack (014/061) and missing information on the rainbow Arceus & Dialga & Palkia GX (091/061). Both stay legal, and Pokémon exchanged them from 4 May to 4 November 2023.
